total_direct_order_comparator.inputs: three finite nonnegative residuals e_C,e_F,e_R in J; finite positive floor_J; finite nonnegative p_min
total_direct_order_comparator.precheck: reject non-finite or negative residual, floor or p_min before any division or logarithm

overall_floor_scopes.FINE_AND_REFERENCE: if e_F<=floor_J and e_R<=floor_J, PASS as OVERALL_FLOOR_RESOLVED and do not evaluate either logarithm
overall_floor_scopes.ALL_THREE: if e_C,e_F,e_R<=floor_J, PASS as OVERALL_FLOOR_RESOLVED and do not evaluate either logarithm

pair_truth_table_in_precedence_order: coarse<=floor_J and fine<=floor_J => PAIR_FLOOR_RESOLVED PASS; no logarithm
coarse<=floor_J and fine>floor_J => REGRESSION_FROM_FLOOR FAIL; no logarithm
coarse>floor_J and fine==0 => EXACT_ZERO_FINE_POSITIVE_ORDER_LIMIT PASS; never serialize Infinity
coarse>floor_J and 0<fine<=floor_J => FINE_FLOOR_RESOLVED_POSITIVE_ORDER_LIMIT PASS; no logarithm
coarse>floor_J and fine>floor_J => compute finite p=log2(coarse/fine), PASS only if p>=p_min
total_direct_order_comparator.three_level_overall_rule: after precheck and any registered overall-floor short circuit, evaluate CF and FR with the pair truth table; PASS only if both pairs PASS

fresh_acquisition_technical_repeat_ident.per_lane_comparison: projected alpha16/5ms bytes and SHA256 == projected alpha16/10ms bytes and SHA256 == projected alpha16/20ms bytes and SHA256

g12_reference_event_and_signed_work_pref.paired_finite_scientific_predicate: fresh_lane_specific_provenance AND both_integrity_pass AND acquisition_time_difference<=0.00025_s AND removal_time_difference<=0.00025_s AND signed_work_difference<=signed_work_tolerance
g12_reference_event_and_signed_work_pref.only_one_reference_finite_rule: evaluation PASS with scientific predicate false; structurally valid but ineligible
g12_reference_event_and_signed_work_pref.aggregate_preflight_pass: all 18 records are complete and structurally valid; each record may truthfully report predicate true, false, or a registered NOT_APPLICABLE outcome

stop_and_failure_rules: BLOCK before any case if a bound B4G/R1 source, invalidation, donor or 264-file raw inventory drifts
BLOCK until an R2 execution source-freeze terminal exists and the explicit rehydrator passes exact donor roundtrip plus registered negative controls
FAIL on schedule mismatch, missing or extra case, non-finite value, hidden mutable-state reuse, fresh certificate reuse, or fresh/common case-id or new-evidence-path reuse
FAIL FRESH_ACQ if any method lacks all three 2:1 steps, any channel violates its Cauchy rule, or technical repeats differ
FAIL a fresh alpha16 case or method-duration refinement if its gate, parity, finite-event, G04, G06, time, work or order rule fails

FAIL COMMON_PROP unless all 18 cases share the exact donor certificate/group hash while using per-case deep-copy objects whose complete donor hashes remain unchanged before and after; also fail on a convergence violation or any G12/selector credit
FAIL contract compliance if runner and validator differ in G04 rule id, fields or boolean expression
STOP after preflight evidence publication; full campaign authorization requires a separate audited decision
